I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm I saw it: 261 seats for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so posting it in the team channel is fine.

She asked for no action, so I did nothing else. I don't have a separate records store, so the number is only kept in her original message in #north-team.
